list.title: Stays
list.nights: {count, plural, =0 {Leaves today} one {# night} two {# nights} few {# nights} many {# nights} other {# nights}}

empty.emptyTitle: No guests are checked in right now
empty.historyEmptyHint: Once guests check out, their stays are kept here as a permanent record.
empty.noMatchHint: Try clearing the search or filters.

list.loadError: We couldn't load your stays. Please try again.
list.readOnlyHint: Your subscription is read-only, so changes are paused.

noAccess.title: You don't have access to stays
noAccess.hint: Ask your manager for the "View stays" permission if you need this page.

guestName.label: Guest name
guestName.hint: As you'd greet them — shown in the guest app and on their requests.

room.label: Room
room.hint: Only vacant, active rooms appear here.
room.empty: No available rooms match your search.
room.noRooms: All rooms are currently occupied or unavailable.

checkOutDate.label: Check-out date
checkOutDate.hint: The stay code stops working after checkout — you can extend the stay anytime.

language.label: Guest language
language.hint: The guest app and notifications reach the guest in this language.

email.label: Email (optional)
email.hint: If filled, we email the guest their stay code and app link.

note.label: Note (optional)
note.placeholder: e.g. Late arrival — keep the key at the desk
note.hint: Visible to your team only — never to the guest.

success.title: {name} is checked in
success.instruction: Hand this code to the guest with the room card — it's their key to the guest app.
success.notShownAgain: For security, this code won't be shown again. If it's lost, open the stay and generate a new one.
success.emailSent: We've also emailed the code to {email}.

stayType.label: Stay type
stayType.hint: The guest's board basis — All-Inclusive guests see included menu items without prices.

unsettledCheck.checkingBody: Check-out opens as soon as we confirm what this stay still owes.
unsettledCheck.failedTitle: We couldn't check for unpaid charges
unsettledCheck.failedBody: This stay may still have uncollected room charges. Check-out is on hold until we can confirm the amount.
unsettledCheck.blockedHint: Check-out stays unavailable until the unpaid charges are verified.

extend.title: Change check-out date
extend.label: New check-out date
extend.hint: Must be after check-in and not in the past.
extend.note: The guest's code and app keep working — nothing is needed from them.

changeRoom.title: Move to another room
changeRoom.note: The guest's code and app keep working — they won't notice anything except the new room.

regenerate.title: Generate a new stay code
regenerate.note: The old code stops working immediately. Devices already signed in stay signed in — only new sign-ins need the new code.

checkout.title: Check out {name}
checkout.note: This ends the stay and signs the guest out of the app on all their devices immediately. The room becomes available right away. This can't be undone — if the guest returns, check them in again with a new code.

checkoutTime.label: Checkout time
checkoutTime.hint: Stays past their check-out date end automatically at this hour, in your hotel's local time.

defaultStayType.label: Default stay type
defaultStayType.hint: Pre-selected at check-in. Resorts usually set All-Inclusive; city hotels keep Room only.
